cbmc.usage: CBMC's default preprocessor on Windows is cl.exe (absent) and it cannot parse MinGW system headers. Preprocess with MinGW gcc against minimal shim headers instead: gcc -E -P -nostdinc -I<shim> file.c -o file.i, then cbmc file.i.
